observations: Photo 0 shows a stack of five tires with visible tread patterns, placed on a dirt ground. A silver alloy wheel is partially visible to the left.
Photo 1 shows the same stack of five tires from a slightly different angle, with more of the tread visible. The same silver alloy wheel is visible to the left.

Photo 2 shows four tires lying flat on the ground, with a person's foot visible at the bottom right. The tires have deep grooves and wear, with some yellowish residue on the tread. Two silver alloy wheels are visible in the background.
All tires appear to be used, with significant tread wear. No visible damage such as cuts or bulges is apparent from the photos.
The seller claims 'Direct Belgium tyres and wheels', but no brand or model is visible on any tire or wheel in the photos.
